g.text: Causal encoder-decoder: where the decoder's global KV comes from during prefill
runs over all N prompt tokens
global branch: Full at 2, 8, 14 (ratio 2), Reuse elsewhere
window branch: every layer, own hidden state
C_l = H_20 W_KV_l, Z_l = H_20 W_Z_l
one projection per decoder layer, no decoder pass
decoder: layers 20 to 39 (not run over the prompt for the global branch)
window KV per decoder layer: missing after early exit
rebuilt by decoder bounded replay: the last 128 prompt tokens' encoder outputs
are run through the 20 decoder layers, windows truncated at the replay start
Prefill complexity: O(N L/2 + n_win L/2) instead of O(N L). Half the layers means half the experts per prompt token:
8B active in prefill, 16B in decode. Decode runs all 40 layers as usual.
